chunks.text: I still think about that Shanghai trip in 2025—everyone kept hyping up the food scene there.
Getting there was a whole story too—I was coming from Beijing to Shanghai, and it felt like half my office was on the same route.
And yeah, the hotel situation in Shanghai was fine in the end, but I remember we compared a bunch of places back then.
For the flight, my coworker had already booked me on China Eastern—flight MU5678—for 2025-03-13, under Zhang Wei, so I didn’t touch any of it.
The hotel was also handled without me—Hanting Hotel People's Square, check-in was 2025-03-19 for 3 nights, and it was under Chen Ming.
Dinner one night was a big group thing—Chuanfu Laozao on 2025-03-04 at 18:00, party size 8. Totally not my planning, I just showed up.

I remember the reservation details because they texted them around—Wang Fang was the contact, phone 13864788741, and she kept reminding us it was for 8. Also, random side note: I even stopped by a pharmacy for some medicine that trip, nothing dramatic.
